podcast: The Ambitious Nurse | Career Strategy for High-Performing Nurses Ready to Advance in Leadership

a253967d2a.q: Why do high-achieving nurses promoted to leadership positions feel stuck and restless even when they like their work?
a253967d2a.a: Many promoted nurses feel like something is missing even though they don't need a new job. The issue is they need unnecessary creation time—the freedom to explore new possibilities and follow practical curiosities outside their day-to-day role. Without this creative outlet, they feel stifled and unable to express their full potential.

52d9b8b7a4.q: What is unnecessary creation time and how does it apply to ambitious nurses?
52d9b8b7a4.a: Unnecessary creation time gives you the freedom to explore new possibilities and follow practical curiosities. For nurses, this means working on out-of-the-box projects, research initiatives, or innovations that could make greater impact on patients nationally or globally—work that may not be a current organizational priority but that you know could be a game changer.

4c47c627a5.q: How can nurses develop new skills and avoid boredom when their day job requires delivering predictable results?
4c47c627a5.a: Unnecessary creation time allows you to take risks and develop new skills that can be applied to your on-demand work. Your tools can become dull and your senses numb when constantly applying the same old methods, yet it is difficult to learn new methods in the midst of your on-demand work because you are paid to deliver predictable results. Engaging in creative activities outside work sharpens those skills for your everyday job.

ee2134a006.q: How did ICU Liberation become a professional outlet for a nurse to work on innovations when her organization lacked support?
ee2134a006.a: A colleague with passion for ICU Liberation saw its impact on patients but faced limitations within her organization to do the work with vigor. She took her talents to the professional organization that supports that work and became one of the major contributors to it at the national level. This allowed her to make impact at her local workplace without feeling stifled, as the national-level work eventually drives implementation of best practices.

ec7a9b8bd4.q: Why should ambitious nurses start a side business or join professional organizations instead of expecting their employer to provide all creative outlets?
ec7a9b8bd4.a: You cannot expect your day-to-day work to help you achieve the creative outlet you are searching for. You must step outside of your work, especially if you enjoy it. Professional organizations or a side business allow you to develop your voice, merge what you work on outside with your everyday work, advance your skills, and remind yourself that you are not the sum of what you make.
